g.text: Stateless greedy policy; 128-token allowance; Hermes parsing. No client-side repair or fallback. Cap: 3,000 moves.

text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #566674

g.text: One trained checkpoint; no SFT comparison. Teacher agreement is imitation, not optimality. Test boards come from 11 games.
